about: drawn after I2RT's photos of the crank gripper (the two product photos of doc.i2rt.com's YAM page and the shop's photos of the gripper and of its tips, 2026-11-12): the fingers of black sintered nylon (the Library's part, whose mesh also holds its carriage plate, bearing block and yoke, so all of it wears the one look), the bead-blasted black anodised rail plate and carriage plate, the black motor and crank, the ground steel rails with their duller sawn ends, the steel bearing block and crank rollers, the dark steel yoke.  Drawn by the project, not the model's (plain boxes and cylinders, bodies/i2rt-yam/drawn-<name>.stl): the green cap and the red seal at each end of both bearing blocks (drawn-block-caps.stl and drawn-block-seals.stl on the sensor finger, drawn-tip-right-caps.stl and drawn-tip-right-seals.stl on the other), the steel body of the sensor finger's bearing block over the model's own block (drawn-block.stl: the part has one look), six black screw heads on the rails, whose tops the model leaves plain (drawn-rail-screws.stl: 10, 30, 50 and 70 mm along each rail as the shop's top view shows them, the one under each bearing block left out), and the bright hub in the middle of the crank with its dark bore (drawn-crank-hub.stl, drawn-crank-hub-bore.stl: flat discs where the real hub lies in a bore).  Not modelled: the knurled rubber pad on the fingers' faces (under the sensor), the black screws of the plates and the fingers, the motor's connector.

finger-nylon.evidence: doc.i2rt.com's first product photo (doc_GP-4310-CS-1): the sintered nylon fingers' flat faces read #3e3e3e, a matte charcoal clearly lighter than the black film laid on them; with the base print-black (the studio at 1.5) the finger behind the film was #2a2a2c at the Exploded home, 9 levels over the film's #212225, so the film all but vanished against it (the verification of 2026-11-13); with the studio at 2.2 it is #3c3d3e there

motor-black.evidence: doc.i2rt.com's two product photos: the motor's can is black all round, #222222 with a wide soft upright highlight (#424242) and no black band; at the base look's numbers this can's coarse facets mirrored the studio's flags as a band darker than the film, and at metalness 0.6 with roughness 0.6 still as one band seen from behind and below (3.5 % of the drawing under luminance 22); at metalness 0.3 and roughness 0.6 there is none from any side looked at (roughness 0.4 brings it back, 0.5 a band darker than the film)

anodized-blasted.evidence: doc.i2rt.com's two product photos and the shop's top view: the rail plate and the fingers' carriage plates are bead-blasted black anodised aluminium, matte, with no highlight band, lighter than the motor and the crank (#272a28 to #434a48 under the flash, the pocket's floor #3c4141 against the crank's #242827, #4d4d4d on the lit flange); a blasted face scatters the light where a mirror would not: at the base look's metalness 0.6 the pocket's floor, seen from the tips as the shop's top view has it, mirrored the room behind the camera at #0f1017, a fifth of the drawing under luminance 22 with the crank lost in it; with these numbers the floor is #23272b to #303337 there

crank-black.evidence: the shop's top view: the crank is a smooth black anodised disc with a bright line on its rim, darker than the blasted floor of the pocket it turns over (#242827 against #3c4141); at the base look's metalness 0.6 its flat face, seen from the tips, mirrored the room behind the camera at #0d0f16, darker than the film and not to be told from the floor; with these numbers it is #1f2127 on the floor's #23272b to #303337

screw-black.evidence: doc.i2rt.com's first product photo and the shop's top view: the rails' screws are black oxide steel, the darkest parts of the gripper (#111313, #3f433f under the flash); at the base look's metalness 0.6 their flat heads, seen from the tips, were under luminance 22

bearing-steel.evidence: doc.i2rt.com's two product photos and the shop's top view: the rails' and the bearing blocks' ground faces are a bright satin grey on every side, #cececc to #d7d8d5 at their brightest and #afb6aa to #c8cec5 seen from the tips, never white and never black; with the base look the rails' tops, seen from the motor's far side, mirrored the overhead softbox at #ebeef2 to #f2f5f9, lost in the card's ground, the sensor finger's block mirrored a flag as a black face between its green caps, and at metalness 0.85 the tops seen from the tips were a dull #727578 (the room behind the camera); with these numbers they are #838583 to #8f9190 there

rail-cut.evidence: doc.i2rt.com's two product photos: each rail ends in its own sawn face with the rail's profile, a warmer, duller grey than the ground top (#a99f91 against #cececc); nothing stands on the rails there

yoke-steel.evidence: the shop's top view: the slotted yoke under each carriage plate is a dark grey steel, a mid grey under the flash, between the black plates and the bright rails

cap-green.evidence: doc.i2rt.com's two product photos and the shop's top view: a green plastic cap at each end of the bearing block (#44976e, #17a370, #489263)

seal-red.evidence: the same photos: a red end seal outside each green cap (#dc4d53 lit, #9b2d28 under the flash, #781b17 in the shade)

hub-turned.evidence: the shop's top view: a bright turned hub in the crank's bore, concentric tool marks, #a2b0ab to #edf4ef; at the base look's metalness 1 the flat disc, seen from the tips as in that photo, mirrored the room behind the camera at #5f6261; at 0.5 it is #969a99
